profile.headline: 🌟️ Senior Software Engineer in TypeScript, Golang, React
profile.summary:
I'm a senior software engineer who loves turning ambiguous problems into products people actually enjoy using. ✨️

Over the past 5+ years, I've built customer-facing platforms, APIs, developer tooling, and web applications using React, TypeScript, and Go. My work spans everything from modernizing legacy systems and improving performance to designing new products and leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through launch. 🚀️

I bring a product-minded approach to engineering and enjoy partnering closely with design, product, and leadership teams to solve complex problems. Whether I'm building intuitive user experiences, designing scalable systems, or exploring new AI-assisted development workflows, I'm motivated by creating solutions that make life easier for users and teammates alike.

Before tech, I worked in entirely different industries, which taught me how to learn quickly, communicate clearly, and stay adaptable - skills that continue to shape how I approach engineering today.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead
positions.description:
TL;DR: Senior software engineer and tech lead responsible for Replicated's customer-facing platform, delivering features across APIs, SDKs, CLI tooling, and React applications that support Kubernetes and Helm deployments. Led cross-functional initiatives, modernized legacy systems, and improved platform performance and reliability using React, TypeScript, and Go while driving product execution from concept to launch.

* Promoted from Software Engineer II to Senior Software Engineer within 3 months.
* Owned and evolved Replicated's customer-facing platform end-to-end, delivering features across public APIs, SDKs, CLI tooling, and web applications to support Kubernetes and Helm application deployment and management workflows.
* Led a team of 4 engineers across customer-facing platform initiatives, driving technical direction, project execution, and cross-functional alignment with Product and Executive Leadership.
* Led the design and implementation of a customer-facing portal for Kubernetes application installs, creating self-service workflows that reduced operational burden and improved deployment experiences for enterprise customers.
* Built high-performance React interfaces handling large-scale datasets through virtualization and optimized state management, improving responsiveness for data-intensive customer workflows.
* Improved backend API scalability and responsiveness through pagination and query optimizations in Golang services, reducing P99 load times by 30%.
* Leveraged rapid prototyping workflows and feature-flag-driven development to validate product direction, explore architecture, and accelerate iteration on experimental customer-facing features.
* Partnered closely with Product and Executive Leadership to align technical implementation with business priorities, communicate technical tradeoffs, and drive cross-functional execution.

projects.title: Coin Tracker
projects.description:
Are you tired of having to log in to seven different exchanges just to see where your crypto portfolio stands? Me too. So, I created Coin Tracker, the site that tracks your cryptocurrency portfolio anonymously - no login necessary.

How does it work?
Coin Tracker keeps track of your holdings by generating a unique URL that it associates with your personal portfolio.

- When you first visit the site, you will be prompted to create a tracker, and then be redirected to your Portfolio. Once there, you'll want to bookmark the page so you can easily visit your Portfolio in the future.

- In the app bar at the top, you'll be able to copy your URL, download your portfolio as a .csv file, or upload a new .csv file.

- From the Portfolio page, you can add, edit, or delete holdings and see a collapsible treemap of your holdings.

- You can view current market data for 400 coins on the Overview page.

Development Features
- Designed fully responsive d3.js treemaps with tooltips to represent market data and portfolio holdings
- Applied React's useContext hook to manage global state
- Built custom useInterval hook using useRef and useEffect in order to manage API calls and update market data every 90 seconds
- Utilized TypeScript to add type safety
- Integrated react-router to handle navigation and site routing
- Implemented Material-UI components to add responsive styling
- Integrated react-hook-form with Material-UI controlled components to handle form validation and manage state of form data
